what.zh: 以 FHIR 為基礎的互通性平台,協助健康保險支付方取得、管理並交換會員的醫療資料,以滿足法規要求與推動價值導向照護。

summary.en: FHIR interoperability platform focused on payer use cases: CMS regulatory compliance, prior authorization workflows, member data quality, value-based care, and risk adjustment.
